ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Pluto

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up home and family.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
Until {H:1812968237000}, the Moon is still in {S:6} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.
